name: Punjab Communications Limited
summary: Punjab Communications Ltd. is a company focused on delivering telecommunications and information technology hardware. The firm provides crucial equipment and services to meet the networking, broadband, and general communication requirements of numerous organizations and service providers throughout India. Its extensive client list includes prominent entities like BSNL, Indian Railways, the Power and Defense sectors, various private businesses, service operators, and corporate bodies. The company was established on July 21, 1981, and its primary operational base is located in Chandigarh, India.
